_comment: Canonical structured-outputs request body for the Anthropic Messages API. Pass the `output_config` object below in client.messages.create(...). This is the current `output_config.format` shape — NOT the deprecated top-level `output_format` param. Adapt `schema.properties` and `required` to your data; keep `additionalProperties: false` so the model can't add stray keys. Supported on Fable 5, Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5, and the legacy Opus 4.8/4.7/4.6/4.5 and Sonnet 4.6/4.5 line — use plain alias ids.
